thread.title: Apple considering buying cobalt directly amid booming demand: report - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple considering buying cobalt directly amid booming demand: report - MarketWatch
text: Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.35% may start buying cobalt directly from miners, according to a Bloomberg report , which says that Apple is concerned about there being a shortage of the material amid booming demand for electric vehicles. Apple is currently holding talks with miners about obtaining cobalt for use in iPhone batteries, Bloomberg reported. Previously, the company relied on its battery suppliers to buy cobalt, the report said. Carmakers are also racing to lock up cobalt contracts as they prepare to make more electric vehicles. Apple's stock is up 0.5% in premarket trading Wednesday and up 26% over the past 12 months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.01% has gained 20% over the past year.
